Excise Jaws: Exemption - Assignment Deed - Case registered under the Excise Jaw against assessee - Assignment of trade mark in favour of assessee subsequent to registration of the case - Assessee claiming benefit under Exemption Notification on 0 the basis Whether or not the Assignment Deed which was entered into between the assessee and the owner of the trade mark on 6. 10. 1998 would date back to period prior to 19.9.1998 when the trade mark was assigned and whether the assessee is entitled to take benefit of Assignment Deed to avail the benefit
